newsitem.title: USA: Ivax faces class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Ivax faces class action suit.

text.p: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Ivax Corp alleging violations of federal securities laws, plaintiffs' attorneys said Monday.
The suit was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida on behalf of all buyers of Ivax common stock and/or call options from August 2 through November 11, 1996.

The complaint alleges the company and certain of its directors and officers misrepresented and omitted material information regarding the company's financial results for at least the second and third fiscal quarters of 1996.
A statement from the attorneys at Wolf Haldenstein Adler Freeman & Herz LLP said the complain focuses particularly on goodwill writeoffs the company would have to take.
Ivax is a Miami-based holding companies whose subsidiaries are engaged primarily in the research, development, manufacture and marketing of health care products.
Attempts to reach Ivax Monday evening were not immediately successful.
